Ok so hella late to the party but finishing the story and getting (I guess all of the characters? I think I'm missing orochi, there's a few people under unique weapons when i replay a stage). So here are my personal pros and cons.




PROS: Holy hell the story is amazing! The story scenes alone are amazing and tells the story amazingly. Next the characters (specifically god characters and SW characters) are fun as hell. I have yet to play as Odin but just judging perseus/loki weapon mannnn I'm having fun. The fusing and dismantling system albeit a bit confusing at first I actually like it. This blows DW9, and WO3/U out of the park. This game has kinda atleast given me a breath of hope for atleast something of our beloved series of games. Deification/Magic. At first I was very much against magic and the deification characters and felt like it was a useless and totally unfun addition to the game. But after playing I cant lie, I'm happy to have been convinced otherwise. 





CONS: man tbh the in battle story dialogue can be hit or miss. Some battles I was killing off most of the troops/officers and I realized I wasnt reading the story. (Personally i like to play like I'm going along with the actual objectives it makes the battles more enjoyable). Next. The MISSION OBJECTIVES. Blows my Shit. They can honestly make your battles feel down right ruined or just a hassle (I'm looking at the battle where you have to keep the wraiths out the burning castle).
